summary: The WelcomeStaffAdmin page is an ASP.NET web page used for managing staff-related functionalities within the HSPnet system. It includes several web controls such as panels, textboxes, dropdown lists, link buttons, validators, and AJAX control extenders. The page is designed to display and filter employment applications by site, discipline, and date range, and includes features to handle errors and warnings.
purpose: The purpose of the WelcomeStaffAdmin page is to facilitate staff administration tasks, enabling users to view and manage employment applications by filtering them based on various criteria like site, discipline, and date range. The page also aims to provide a seamless user experience with JavaScript enhancements and validation.
